name: Orell Füssli AG
summary: Orell Füssli AG, together with its subsidiaries, engages in security printing and technology, book retailing, and publishing business in Switzerland, Germany, Rest of Europe and Africa, North and South America, Asia, and Oceania. It operates through Security Printing, Industrial Systems, Book Retailing, and Other Business Areas segments.
